# APEX Fitness

> Modern gym & body-weight tracker (AGPL-3.0). Runs as a standalone
> Android app (sideloaded APK) or self-hosted with Docker (passkey profiles,
> multi-device sync, PWA). No account required, no third-party cloud, no telemetry.

## Docs
- [Complete reference](https://apex-fitness.vercel.app/docs.html): every feature, self-hosting, every .env setting, AI Coach, imports (FitNotes/Strong/Hevy/Apple Health), backups, MCP server, troubleshooting
- [HTTP API](https://apex-fitness.vercel.app/api.html): OpenAPI spec, also at [openapi.yaml](https://apex-fitness.vercel.app/openapi.yaml)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swapnil-exxe/apex-fitness/main/README.md): project overview in Markdown
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/swapnil-exxe/apex-fitness/blob/main/docs/README.md): every guide by audience, plus an [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swapnil-exxe/apex-fitness/main/docs/FAQ.md)

## Try & get it
- [Live demo](https://apex-fitness.vercel.app): the real app with example data, in the browser
- [Android APK](https://github.com/swapnil-exxe/apex-fitness/releases/latest): signed, sideloadable; SHA-256 next to it on the GitHub release
- [About](https://apex-fitness.vercel.app/about.html): the story and every release

## How it is built
- Developed with advanced AI engineering workflows; changes are reviewed, tested and released with automated continuous verification. The app itself needs no third-party AI service; the AI coach and MCP server are optional.

## Source & community
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/swapnil-exxe/apex-fitness): code, issues, pull requests, releases
